name: slot_on_narrow_plate_0
why: THE ROTATION MUST BE SEEN, AND THE VOLUME DOES NOT SEE IT: turning a slot does not change how much material it removes. To make it observable a NARROW plate is needed, where the slot fits lengthwise and not widthwise. This is the zero-degree case, and it is entirely inside.

expect.tolerance_why: 160000 minus 535.0332 over 20: the calculation has pi inside
